subject.title: fix(skill-workshop): validate apply body and show change summary before destructive writes

question: Should structurally valid but weakly related full-skill replacements override the default automatic approval policy and require explicit approval?
rationale: This determines the permanent trust boundary between an uninterrupted agent workflow and protection against destructive replacement of user-authored skill content; source correctness alone cannot choose that product policy.

options.title: Gate risky replacements
options.body: Keep automatic approval for ordinary edits but require explicit approval when the tested overlap classifier indicates a likely full replacement.

options.title: Preserve unconditional auto
options.body: Reject structurally invalid content but automatically apply every structurally valid replacement when the configured policy is auto.

options.title: Approve every update
options.body: Require explicit approval for all update applies, maximizing safety while restoring the workflow interruption removed by the recent default change.

recommendation.title: Gate risky replacements
recommendation.body: Keep automatic approval for ordinary edits but require explicit approval when the tested overlap classifier indicates a likely full replacement.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the automatic lifecycle approval default that this PR conditionally overrides.
